And why should I come with Katya?
Well, I just thought so.
She really likes you, after all.
Max, bring me that, do this for me.
What made you think that she likes me?
By all the signs, everything adds up.
By what kind of signs?
First, she looks only at you.
That person always tries to touch you.

examples.text: В любой момент.
examples.trans: Any time.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'your', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: И третье — это любые твои шутки.
examples.trans: And third, any of your jokes.

examples.text: У вас ужасное чувство юмора, Максим.
examples.trans: You have a terrible sense of humor, Maxim.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно проверить тут электричество.
examples.trans: I need to urgently check the electricity here.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'jokes' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: И третье — это любые твои шутки.
examples.trans: And third, any of your jokes.

examples.text: Катя, ты знаешь шутку про чёрный кофе?
examples.trans: Katya, do you know the joke about black coffee?

examples.text: Какая глупая шутка, но очень забавно.
examples.trans: What a silly joke, but very funny.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'куда').

examples.text: Откуда ты всё это знаешь, Настя?
examples.trans: How do you know all this, Nastya?

examples.text: Откуда ты?
examples.trans: Where are you from?

examples.text: Откуда это слово?
examples.trans: Where does that word come from?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'know'.

examples.text: Он всегда точно знает, что делать.
examples.trans: He always knows exactly what to do.

examples.text: По всем признакам всё сходится.
examples.trans: By all the signs, everything adds up.

examples.text: По каким ещё таким признакам?
examples.trans: By what kind of signs?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Он всегда точно знает, что делать.
examples.trans: He always knows exactly what to do.

examples.text: По признакам всё точно сходится.
examples.trans: By the signs, everything matches up.

examples.text: Они этого точно не дождутся!
examples.trans: They definitely won't get that!
